hero.eyebrow: Remote delivery / Central Australia service area
hero.heading: Community-led support for
hero.intro: GT Marketing supports Aboriginal organisations, art centres, tourism and regional enterprises across Central Australia through remote-first collaboration, low-bandwidth options and scheduled travel by arrangement.

servicesHeading: Communications and digital support designed for distance, culture and organisational capacity.
servicesIntro: Central Australian organisations often work across remote communities, cultural responsibilities, funding programs and dispersed audiences. The project structure needs to reflect that reality from the beginning.

services.title: Community communications
services.description: Plain-language and public-facing communication developed with clear review and approval pathways.

services.title: Funding & reporting support
services.description: Help with grant narratives, business planning, capability material and reporting structures without promising funding outcomes.

services.title: Art & cultural enterprise
services.description: Digital presence, e-commerce and storytelling support for art centres and cultural enterprises with attention to provenance and cultural authority.

services.title: Tourism journeys
services.description: Visitor information, booking pathways and practical digital content for experiences that need clear expectations and culturally appropriate representation.

services.title: Remote digital access
services.description: Simple, mobile-friendly digital experiences and review processes designed to work under constrained connectivity.

services.title: Capability handover
services.description: Templates, documentation and training designed so internal teams can maintain the work without permanent agency dependence.

localHeading: Central Australia is a service region, not a claimed office location.
localParagraphs: GT Marketing remains based in Darwin City. Central Australia is supported remotely and through agreed travel rather than being represented as a physical GT Marketing office.
Project plans can account for time zones, community schedules, travel, limited connectivity and the need for multiple levels of approval.
Where cultural material is involved, use is guided by the organisation and relevant cultural authority. GT Marketing does not assume ownership or permission.
serviceAreaNote: Remote delivery is available across Central Australia. In-person and on-Country work is subject to project need, permission, timing and agreed travel arrangements.

faqs.question: Do you have an office in Central Australia?
faqs.answer: No. GT Marketing is based in Darwin City. Central Australia is a remote service region and is not represented as a separate office.

faqs.question: Can you support an art centre or cultural tourism enterprise?
faqs.answer: Yes. Work can include digital presence, e-commerce or booking journeys, storytelling and communications, with client-led approval processes for cultural material and intellectual property.

faqs.question: Can the project be run mostly remotely?
faqs.answer: Yes. Remote-first collaboration is available, using phone, video, shared documents and low-bandwidth options. Travel can be added where it is useful and appropriate.

closing.heading: Build practical communications around the organisation and the community—not the other way around.
